mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS drops > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO rises > 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and real final sales (RSAFS) also increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% MoM and RSAFS rises > 1% MoM
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase as specified.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: During an economic expansion, a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals accommodative policy and strong supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and INDPRO rises > 1% MoM
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and INDPRO increases > 1% MoM during an economic expansion.
